test_add_prefix: test the Series.add_prefix method to prepend a string prefix to all index labels
test_add_suffix: test the Series.add_suffix method to append a string suffix to all index labels
test_add_prefix_suffix_axis: test the Series.add_prefix and add_suffix methods with explicit axis=0 parameter
test_add_prefix_suffix_invalid_axis: test that Series.add_prefix and add_suffix raise ValueError for invalid axis value
test_add_prefix_special_characters: test Series.add_prefix and add_suffix with special characters like # and %
